operations.name: format
operations.shell: set -e; set -o pipefail; source /workspace/.lerna-env/env.sh; git diff --check; git ls-files -z -- "*.go" | xargs -0 gofmt -l > /tmp/lerna-04-ticket05-execution/final-format-files.txt; cat /tmp/lerna-04-ticket05-execution/final-format-files.txt; test ! -s /tmp/lerna-04-ticket05-execution/final-format-files.txt

operations.name: vet
operations.shell: set -e; set -o pipefail; source /workspace/.lerna-env/env.sh; go vet -tags=integration ./...

operations.name: go-normal
operations.shell: set -e; set -o pipefail; source /workspace/.lerna-env/env.sh; go test -v ./... -count=1 -timeout=120s

operations.name: go-race
operations.shell: set -e; set -o pipefail; source /workspace/.lerna-env/env.sh; go test -v -race ./... -count=1 -timeout=120s
